scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Dino became our landlord this week. His first victim was the couch.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: After seating, he monetized the temperature. Our budget immediately caught a cold.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Then he demanded a deposit. Max had a plan, which usually costs extra.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: With the money collected, new house rules arrived. We were reclassified.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: The ceiling started leaking. For once, Zig could fix the actual problem.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: A dry ceiling did not prevent an inspection. Concealment became the strategy.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: We needed a better lease. Unfortunately, Max handled the negotiations again.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Next week, we need rent money. Should we open a dinosaur daycare or sell robot repairs? Choose below.
